basic_details.job_title: District Court Beed Cleaner Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Court Beed Cleaner Notification 2026 has been released on 27 July 2026 on the official website of District Court Beed. A total of 2 vacancies have been announced through the District Court Beed Cleaner Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 38 years Age Relaxation: Up to 43 years for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC etc.)

selection_process: Practical Examination Physical Efficiency Test Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for District Court Beed Cleaner Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://beed.dcourts.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Court Beed Cleaner Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://beed.dcourts.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Court Beed Cleaner recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the District Court Beed Cleaner recruitment is 10-08-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Cleaner post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Cleaner post is passing the 7th standard. This makes the opportunity accessible to a wide range of candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The age limit for applying to the Cleaner post is between 18 years and 38 years. However, age relaxation is provided for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Safai Gar post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Cleaner post in the District Court Beed recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Safai Gar position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Cleaner post will receive a monthly salary in the range of Rs. 15000 to Rs. 47600.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the District Court Beed Cleaner recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Safai Gar post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Safai Gar post includes a Practical Examination, a Physical Efficiency Test, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the Safai Gar recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of 500 for all categories including General/OBC and SC/ST for the Safai Gar recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Court Beed, which is https://beed.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates with the application form.
